name: Voxelize Point Cloud (Basic Mode)
definition: A voxelization mode that calculates grid spacing based on a user-requested number of cells per axis (N) and the point cloud's bounding box extent, then applies a fixed padding to the extent before recalculating dimensions.
summary: Voxelize Point Cloud (Basic Mode) dynamically sets grid dimensions from a target cell count but applies fixed padding, causing output sizes to deviate from the requested value.
